name: The Rope Ladder (UE4SS Loader)
author: William112792
description: The UE4SS framework used by the small script mods listed below. It does not change a run by itself; it gives those scripts somewhere to load.
requirement: Required by Scarlet's Rope Hits The Gym, This Rope Is Lit (Literally), and Luck Be A Lady.
usage: Install so the ue4ss folder sits beside the Scarlet Skips executable, then place supported scripts in ue4ss/Mods.

name: Scarlet's Rope Hits The Gym
author: William112792
description: Adds a manual rope-maintenance shortcut: pressing F5 triggers a Reinforce effect on the current rope.
requirement: Requires The Rope Ladder UE4SS loader.
usage: Use F5 during a run. This changes normal upgrade pacing, so keep it for experimental or accessibility-minded runs rather than comparing scores as unmodded play.

name: This Rope Is Lit (Literally)
author: William112792
description: Automatically applies the Ignite effect to a rope about every 600 milliseconds, turning fire from a late build choice into a constant rule.
requirement: Requires The Rope Ladder UE4SS loader.
usage: Expect a much more aggressive score pattern and visuals than the base game. Do not use it as evidence for normal fire timing or multiplier behavior.

name: Luck Be A Lady (Every 5 Seconds)
author: William112792
description: Adds five Luck every five seconds. The author lists it as automatic with no in-game toggle.
requirement: Requires The Rope Ladder UE4SS loader.
usage: This bypasses the base game's random card economy. Treat scores and upgrade pacing from a modded session separately from standard runs.

name: Princess Daisy
author: Lilotty
description: A character replacement listed by its author with the short description “Hi, I'm Daisy!”
requirement: The public listing does not state a UE4SS dependency.
usage: Check the Files and Requirements tabs on Nexus before installing; the listing copy is too brief to safely invent extra steps here.

name: LUAN GAMEPLAY
author: Somyst
description: A replacement mod listed in Portuguese. Its public summary does not provide enough detail for this guide to claim changes beyond the replacement itself.
requirement: No dependency is stated in the public summary we verified.
usage: Read the current Nexus description and requirements before copying files; this page deliberately avoids guessing from the thumbnail or title.
